Treatment summary
Patient presented following a collision sustained while turning left, with a diagnosed
wrist fracture confirmed on imaging and supported by consistent findings on physical
examination. Care was delivered over twenty visits, consisting of immobilization,
serial radiographs, progressive range-of-motion exercises, and follow-up assessment of
grip strength and function. The duration of treatment ran somewhat longer than is
typical for a fracture of this type, which we attribute to slower healing progression
and the patient's gradual return to daily activities. The patient reports no prior
injury to the same area, and our records do not reflect any earlier complaints
involving this wrist. At this point it remains unclear whether the fracture is fully
attributable to the reported collision, and further review of the mechanism of injury
may be warranted. Billing records reviewed for this episode show no repeated charegs
for the same services. Ongoing follow-up is recommended to monitor healing and
functional recovery.

"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.

address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
